messages:
jess_support: FYI customer BrightFleet opened a high-severity about p99 latency after last night's deploy. They report p99 ~520ms (was ~180ms baseline) for /v1/generate. Dashboard link: https://redwood.dash/u/BRIGHT/panels/7345 and ticket BF-889. They say traces (raw spans) don't show the same jump.

nate_sre: Can you paste the exact panel query and timeframe? Is the panel using histogram_quantile over rollups or raw percentile series? Also which model and region are they hitting?

jess_support: Panel code from Grafana: ```histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="redwood-api",route="/v1/generate",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))``` Timeframe: last 24h, spike started ~2026-03-15T02:10Z after deploy-2026-03-15-02. Model: redwood-3b-quantized, region: us-east-1. Customer attached curl results showing most individual requests ~120-200ms.

kai_obs: This smells like rollup/bucket aliasing. Our rollup pipeline re-buckets histograms into canonical boundaries every 1m window; when tails are sparse the histogram_quantile can stair-step and overestimate p99 vs direct trace sampling. Also check if the rollup window changed in that deploy.

ivan_runtime: Confirmed: deploy-2026-03-15 modified obs config: "rollup_window = 5m" for service api-proxy to reduce churn. That increases aggregation smoothing and can inflate quantile estimates when the distribution is multimodal. Logs snippet from deploy: ```2026-03-15T02:00:01Z INFO apply_config rollup_window=5m```

nate_sre: Repro steps for obs team to validate: 1) run raw histogram buckets for a short time window: ```sum(rate(api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{...}[15s])) by (le)``` 2) compute histogram_quantile(0.99, ...) on that 15s window 3) compare with rollup-produced 5m panel. Also run direct curl loop against same route from within us-east-1 to compare. Example: ```for i in $(seq 1 200); do curl -s -w '%{time_total}\n' -o /dev/null 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; done | sort -n | awk 'NR==int(0.99*NR){print $0}'```

kai_obs: I'm running the 15s/raw queries now. Early result: short-window raw p99 ~190ms, rollup 5m p99 ~510ms. That matches customer report. The root cause is the new rollup_window setting combined with our downsampling into 10 canonical buckets; we lose tail mass between windows and the estimator overweights older slow samples.

ivan_runtime: Short-term mitigation options: - revert rollup_window to 1m for api-proxy (fast) - teach dashboards to use tdigest-based percentiles from trace store (medium) - route BrightFleet traffic to dedicated pool with lower queueing (immediate). I can push a routing change now if ops agrees.

nate_sre: Let's avoid a full revert during peak. Do routing move for the customer first so they see improvement, and open a follow-up to evaluate rollup_window default. ivan_runtime, can you run the routing change? Use rbctl: ```rbctl routing update --customer brightfleet --pool dedicated-brightfleet --reason "p99 rollback mitigation" --apply``` 

ivan_runtime: Executing now. ```deploybot: routing-change submitted by ivan_runtime for brightfleet -> dedicated-brightfleet (request id rchg-9901)```

deploybot: routing-change applied by automation at 2026-03-15T02:23:12Z. Link: https://rbctl.redwood/changes/rchg-9901

maria_support: I told BrightFleet we've applied a mitigation (dedicated pool) and asked them to confirm latency on their side. They replied: "seeing p99 drop to ~200-230ms in the last 10m, much better".

jess_support: Great. Next steps: 1) obs team to produce a short doc explaining how rollup_window + canonical bucketing affects histogram_quantile and recommended dashboard queries (use raw 15s windows or tdigest when available). 2) infra/runtime to propose a safer default for rollup_window (maybe 1m) and run canary if changed. 3) set up alerting to compare rollup_p99 vs trace_p99 and signal large divergence. I'll file BF-889 follow-up and mark mitigation done for now.

kai_obs: I'll draft the doc and add a sample Grafana panel that computes p99 from raw series and another based on tdigest traces. Also adding a Grafana annotation to mark when rollup_window changed.

nate_sre: Adding postmortem check: did any other customers hit the same pattern? Running query across top-20 tenants.

jess_support: Thanks everyone. BrightFleet is unblocked, closing customer-facing incident. We'll keep internal thread open for the postmortem content."
